audit_boundary: Frozen source-authority audit. In ADR03-ADR06 the TaskSpec makes consumer inventory and consumer contracts packet-prohibited reviewer observations; any root result from the design container that contains or does not prove exclusion of those projections is mixed-owner admission. Direct reviewer reads of those projections are required, and a root preread plus reviewer read is duplicate consumption. Explicit reviewer final statements are used only to establish observed prohibited packet delivery; encrypted spawn payloads are not inferred. ADR07 and ADR09 require exactly one paired-scope target read and no design-container or outside reviewer read. Base reviewer cardinality, result admission/effect, terminal, command, and forbidden-input predicates remain binding.

root_design_commands: /bin/zsh -lc "jq -e '(.required_validation.observed_properties == [\"member-a version\", \"member-b version\", \"equality relation\"]) and (.required_validation.unobserved_properties == []) and (.artifacts[\"member-a\"].version == .artifacts[\"member-a\"].required_version) and (.artifacts[\"member-b\"].version == .artifacts[\"member-b\"].required_version) and (.artifacts[\"member-a\"].version == .artifacts[\"member-b\"].version)' evaluation-fixture/design-admission.json"
/bin/zsh -lc 'git rev-parse HEAD HEAD''^ HEAD''^''^ && sed -n '"'1,260p' evaluation-fixture/design-admission.json"

/bin/zsh -lc "jq '{identity, task_contract, authority, boundary_normative_contract, general_design: {semantic: .general_design.semantic}, boundary_ledger, required_validation, consumer_inventory, consumer_contracts, review_contract}' evaluation-fixture/design-admission.json"

/bin/zsh -lc "jq '{identity, task_contract, authority, general_design: {semantic: .general_design.semantic}, boundary_ledger, required_validation, consumer_inventory, consumer_contracts, review_contract}' evaluation-fixture/design-admission.json"
